title: CBIZ Construction Practice Ranked Among Top Providers by Construction Executive
summary: Construction Executive ranked CBIZ among the top three accounting firms serving the construction industry, recognizing industry-focused expertise.
body_markdown:
*Construction Executive* released its latest ranking of account firms for 2026, naming CBIZ among the top-three providers serving the national construction industry. This is the second consecutive year that the publisher has named CBIZ a top three firm and further reinforces the strong reputational gains of the firm’s dedicated industry group.


Construction group leader Joe Natarelli attributes the recognition to the firm’s longstanding dedication to meeting the market’s evolving needs. “At CBIZ, we know clients don’t stand still, so we don’t either. We’re continually on the look out for new ways to bring creative benefits to clients, with a steadfast focus on the bottom line and how to move their most meaningful metrics. We’ve recently made effectively adopting AI, exit planning, and adapting to evolving market conditions central to our offerings so our clients see tangible results and can swim with, not against, macroeconomic currents and the technological revolution currently underway.”


For more on the actionable guidance CBIZ delivers to clients everyday, read our recent construction-focused *Insights That Impact* :


- [Construction Accounting Methods for Financial Reporting and Income Tax Reporting](https://www.cbiz.com/insights/article/construction-accounting-methods-for-financial-reporting-and-income-tax-reporting) – See our breakdown on financial and income tax reporting and the various accounting methods that can be employed when projects are eligible.
- [Pros and Cons of Common Exit Strategies for Construction Owners](https://www.cbiz.com/insights/article/the-pros-and-cons-of-common-exit-options-for-construction-owners-esops-pe-third-party-sales) – With dealmaking on the rise, business leaders need to know the pros and cons of various exit options. Read our recent comparative coverage for an introduction to the benefits and drawbacks of ESOPs, private equity, and third-party sales.
- [The AI Imperative, Use Cases, and Principles for the Market Ready Contractor](https://www.cbiz.com/insights/article/the-ai-imperative-use-cases-and-principles-for-the-market-ready-contractor) – Learn how AI stands to reshape construction with a look at proven use-cases already at work within the industry.
- [Transforming Sales Tax Compliance for a Multi-State Construction Materials Provider](https://www.cbiz.com/insights/case-study/transforming-sales-tax-compliance-for-a-multi-state-construction-materials-provider) – See a real-world example of CBIZ cutting through tax complexity to save a client time and money.
- [Construction Survey](https://www.cbiz.com/industries/construction/construction-survey) – Every year CBIZ collects and analyzes data from the national industry to produce our annual overview of the industry, including thought leadership that digs into the details to present actionable insights.[Download our latest edition here.](https://www.cbiz.com/industries/construction/construction-survey)
